steps.title: Access Spotify Web API Developer Dashboard
steps.purpose: Establish application identity and access developer credentials.
steps.whereToGo: https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard > "Spotify Developer Dashboard > Dashboard > Create App > Settings"
steps.instructions: Navigate to https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Sign in and go to: "Spotify Developer Dashboard > Dashboard > Create App > Settings".
steps.howToVerify: Confirm browser loads the developer dashboard at "Spotify Developer Dashboard > Dashboard > Create App > Settings".

steps.title: Register New OAuth Application in Spotify Web API
steps.purpose: Registers your client identity with the authorization server.
steps.instructions: Click "developer.spotify.com/dashboard > "Create App"". Complete the registration form fields: App name, App description, Website, Redirect URIs, API/SDK choice: "Web API".
steps.expectedOutcome: Application created in developer console. Client ID is generated.
steps.howToVerify: Verify application entry appears in dashboard with generated Client ID.

steps.title: Configure Authorized Redirect URIs
steps.purpose: Prevents authorization code interception by locking callbacks to your server.
steps.instructions: In the redirect settings, enter your callback URL (e.g. "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/spotify"). Note: The example uses http://localhost:3000 for local development testing. Redirect URI requirements: Must match the URI registered with the provider. HTTPS is generally required for deployed applications; localhost exceptions may apply during development. Confirm the exact rules for the selected provider and app type. Save changes.
steps.howToVerify: Confirm saved redirect URI appears under whitelisted callbacks with exact matching protocol.

steps.title: Select Permission Scopes & Secure Client Secret
steps.purpose: Configures granular API access permissions and obtains server credentials.
steps.instructions: Retrieve your Client ID and generate your Client Secret. Supported scopes: user-read-private (Access user account country, product subscription level, and profile details.), user-read-email (Access user email address verified with Spotify.), playlist-read-private (Read private playlists created by the user.), playlist-modify-public (Create and modify public playlists on user behalf.), user-top-read (Read user top artists and tracks based on listening history.). Scope location rule: Scopes are dynamically requested during user redirect via scope query parameter.. Store Client Secret in backend environment variables.
steps.expectedOutcome: Client Secret securely placed in server environment.
steps.howToVerify: Verify Client Secret string is copied and referenced in server .env without exposing in client code.
steps.commandOrSnippet:
SPOTIFY_WEB_API_CLIENT_ID="your_client_id_here"
SPOTIFY_WEB_API_CLIENT_SECRET="[REDACTED_CLIENT_SECRET]"
# Note: http://localhost:3000 is used for local development testing only; deployed production applications require HTTPS
REDIRECT_URI="http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback"

steps.title: Implement Spotify Web API Authorization & Token Exchange
steps.purpose: Complete standard OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Flow with PKCE) flow.
steps.whereToGo: Backend Callback Route & Client Auth Redirect Handler
steps.instructions: Direct users to authorization endpoint: "https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope=user-read-private%20user-read-email". Exchange authorization code by POSTing to token endpoint: "https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token".
steps.expectedOutcome: Server receives JSON payload containing access_token, token_type: Bearer, and expiration.
steps.howToVerify: Execute test code exchange and verify response JSON has 200 OK with valid access_token.

troubleshooting.description: The redirect_uri parameter in your request has not been added to the whitelist in Spotify Developer Dashboard.
troubleshooting.resolution: Open developer.spotify.com/dashboard > Select App > Settings > Add your exact callback URL to Redirect URIs and click Save.
troubleshooting.symptom: The redirect_uri parameter in your request has not been added to the whitelist in Spotify Developer Dashboard.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Inspect request parameters against console configuration: Missing URI in dashboard; Trailing slash mismatch; Encoding issues in redirect_uri parameter.
troubleshooting.verification: Retry authorization request and confirm expected OAuth code or token response is returned.
